Holley booters edge rival Kendall

By Mike Wertman, Sports Writer Posted 15 September 2026 at 9:40 pm
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Holley edged rival Kendall 2-1 in a Genesee Region League boys soccer game this evening at Holley.

Tarek Garrett and Chase Kempa each scored a goal for Holley. Cooper Wolf assisted on Garrett’s goal.

Brenden Eichas scored for Kendall off an assist from Andrew Coker.

Holley is now 3-0 overall and Kendall 2-1
